summary: Verified server-side blocked-countries fix (bug: blocklist previously in per-device localStorage). Backend endpoints tested via curl (GET public 200, POST 401 without/with wrong pass, POST 200 with X-Admin-Pass candice2026, normalized/deduped/sorted uppercase). Frontend integration tested via Playwright: (1) fresh visitor with cleared localStorage + monkeypatched ipapi returning US gets body.geo-blur, #travel .location filter blur(12px), banner display:flex — proving list comes from server not localStorage; (2) FR visitor with server list=['US'] NOT blurred; (3) admin (isLoggedIn) exempted from enforceGeoBlock; (4) preview button [data-testid=preview-blocked-btn] toggles blur on/off; (5) admin round-trip via UI: clicking United States row POSTs to backend (server GET returns ['US']), unblocking returns []; (6) regression: empty server list = no blur, banner hidden. Server list reset to [] at end.
critical_code_review_comments: enforceGeoBlock() silently catches ipapi.co CORS/network failures (documented as failure-open). In this preview env ipapi.co is CORS-blocked from browser origin, meaning boot-time enforceGeoBlock always fails to detect country for real visitors here. Not a bug in the blocklist fix, but worth noting: production may need a server-side geo-lookup or a CORS-friendly IP service if reliability matters.

toggleBlocked() updates local state and localStorage BEFORE the POST resolves, and only shows an error toast on failure — the local cache can diverge from the server if the POST fails. Consider syncing back from server on non-OK response.
restrictSensitive() still only strips <option> matching /in person/i — same regex-centralization comment as iteration 8 still applies.
getBlocked()/setBlocked() localStorage cache is now only a fallback for backend-down scenarios; consider clearing it on successful server sync to reduce risk of stale-cache confusion for developers.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 curl assertions: GET public 200, POST no-auth 401, POST wrong-pass 401, POST valid 200 + normalize FR/PH/US, GET reflects saved, reset to [])
success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 scenarios: US blocked visitor blur, FR not blurred, admin exempt, preview toggle, admin round-trip via UI, empty-list regression)

test_credentials: Backstage/admin pass: candice2026. Login via Ctrl+Shift+K → #adminPassInput. NOT changed.
seed_data_creation: Server 'blocked_countries' setting toggled to ['US'] and then reset to [] during tests. Final state verified empty [].
context_for_next_testing_agent: KEY assertion proven: with localStorage.clear() (candice_blocked_countries=null) and server list=['US'], monkeypatched ipapi returning US → body.geo-blur added, blur(12px) applied to [data-restrict], banner shows. This confirms fix: blocklist now sourced from backend, not per-device localStorage. Preview button [data-testid=preview-blocked-btn] is only rendered on the COUNTRIES tab (.admin-tab[data-tab='geo']) — must switch tab before clicking. syncBlockedFromServer() runs on openAdmin() and on switchTab('geo'). Admin UI toggleBlocked() POSTs to /api/blocked-countries with X-Admin-Pass header from getPass() (localStorage candice_admin_pass, defaults to candice2026). Blur CSS is filter:blur(12px)!important on body.geo-blur [data-restrict].
rca of the issue: Original bug: blocked-country list was per-device (localStorage 'candice_blocked_countries'), so real visitors' browsers always had an empty list. Admin's block choices never propagated. Fix (verified): new backend endpoints GET/POST /api/blocked-countries backed by db.settings key 'blocked_countries'; enforceGeoBlock fetches from server (localStorage only as offline fallback); toggleBlocked persists to server; openAdmin and switchTab('geo') sync from server. Verified end-to-end that a browser with NULL localStorage still gets blurred when its ipapi country_code matches the server list.
